image_description: A product shot of a box of 'Band-Aid' brand adhesive bandages featuring Angry Birds characters. The box is yellow and green with the 'BAND-AID' logo at the top. In front of the box, there is a fanned-out display of several individual bandage wrappers (blue with character art) and one unwrapped bandage lying flat in the foreground. The unwrapped bandage has an orange/brown backing and a central white pad.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The unwrapped bandage in the foreground clearly exhibits the standard rectangular shape and proportions consistent with a fingertip bandage.
The visible bandage has distinct rounded corners and a narrow rectangular form factor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central absorbent pad slightly raised above surrounding adhesive surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The white central pad is visually distinct from the orange backing, appearing slightly textured and raised, consistent with an absorbent gauze pad.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central absorbent pad surrounded by adhesive-coated fabric or plastic backing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The orange material surrounding the white pad represents the adhesive-backed fabric/plastic layer.

The central pad on the foreground bandage is clearly white.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The backing is an orange/tan color. While specific perforations are hard to resolve at this resolution, the texture appears consistent with standard breathable fabric backings found on branded bandages.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some variants feature printed patterns bright colors or character designs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The packaging and the visible wrappers explicitly feature colorful Angry Birds character designs, matching this checkpoint for variant types.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The main logo text reads 'BAALIAS' or similar nonsensical characters instead of 'BAND-AID'. The letterforms are distorted and malformed, a common AI artifact in rendering known brand logos.

artifact_observations.location: Lower right corner of the box face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The smaller text block describing the product features is illegible gibberish. The characters melt into each other and do not form recognizable words or sentences.
The print on the blue wrappers appears slightly smeared and lacks the crisp edge definition expected of mass-produced foil/plastic packaging. The character faces are somewhat distorted.
